takes place in a canyon. In the canyon, there are four main areas above a grey fog, connected by stone bridges. There, a few trees, rocks and tree stumps can be found. There is also a stone house with a red roof and two ceilings. Wooden fences can also be seen near the house, on the edges of the terrain.

The stone path starts and ends at a cave. The path takes multiple turns and goes across multiple bridges.

had four islands that were seen above the low cloud, with one island not being reached to by the path. Several trees, colored green and light brown, could be seen planted across the map. There appeared to be signs of human habitation; several huts could be seen across the map as well as wooden steps onto one of the islands.

The black pebble path began and ended at two caves. It took quite a long straight, onto a bridge. The bridge then turned twice onto the second island where the majority of the turns on this map were. The path then went onto a second bridge and underneath a sign before reaching the end.
